title: A Gated Residual Block
tagline: Step through the WaveNet/TCN unit where a tanh proposes content, a sigmoid gates it, and skip plus residual paths make deep stacks trainable
summary: Press Step to reveal one gated residual block stage by stage: input x goes through a dilated causal conv, splits into a tanh content branch and a sigmoid gate branch, multiplies them into z = tanh(W_f*x) o sigma(W_g*x), passes a 1x1 conv, then peels off a skip copy and adds a residual copy back to x. A gate-bias knob opens and shuts the valves so you can watch the product z grow and shrink. The repeating unit behind WaveNet and Temporal Convolutional Networks.
highlights: Step through one block one stage at a time: conv, tanh content, sigmoid gate, product, 1x1 conv, skip, residual add.
Watch the gated activation z = tanh(W_f*x) o sigma(W_g*x) form as an element-wise product of content and gate.
Turn a gate-bias knob and see the sigmoid valves open and shut, scaling each channel of the product z.
See the skip path peel off to the output head while the residual path adds back to x so deep stacks stay trainable.
Drive the gate to zero and watch the block degrade gracefully to a no-op, with the residual carrying x through untouched.
